The Artificial Intelligence department at IRIT, Université de Toulouse, opened an assistant professor (maitre de conférence) position for 2026.

Profile: Machine learning and knowledge representation

Keywords: Symbolic AI / Hybrid AI / Machine learning / Explainability

Full job description and contact details in attachment. Applications on Galaxie.

Looking forward to read your applications!
